value_review.accepted_cost_reason: The prospective mechanism MVP answers a project-critical question that historical replay cannot answer: whether the frozen DWD-to-expert-to-aggregator-to-paper chain remains outcome-blind, reproducible and authority-safe under real future information arrival. The bounded calendar cost is accepted because no P5 or Stage expansion is required and weak or negative strategy results remain valid evidence.
value_review.implementation_value: Build the minimum reusable prospective data boundary first; do not pre-authorize scorecards, worker, paper, Web or activation until their dependency gates are separately accepted.

claim_ceiling: This decision opens P6-DATA-001 implementation only. It does not activate P6, admit prospective evidence, authorize scorecards, Forward Worker, paper, Web, notification, broker, live capital, new experts, Stage action semantics, P5, arbitration 2022-2024 or permanent-blind 2025.
